text: I can state a design decision in the five-part shape: options, criteria taken from the requirements, comparison, decision with its cost, and a revisit trigger.
I can turn "it depends" into a decision by naming the variable, reading its value from my estimates, and deriving a threshold, as in the news-feed fan-out example.
I can tell a probe from new information from an error, and respond by defending, re-deciding or conceding, each with a stated reason.
I can answer a question I don't know by saying exactly what I don't know, reasoning from a related figure, and showing the design survives a 2× error.
I keep a decision log on the board during a mock and use it to answer the trade-offs criterion at wrap-up.
